title: Amazing day!
text: We had an amazing day in Alhambra with our guide Carlos, who was extremely kind, personable, and extremely knowledgeable about the secrets and history of Alhambra. I am traveling with my elderly parents who have some trouble with mobility and when I messaged Carlos the day earlier about possibly slowing down the pace, he graciously offered the options for a longer, but slower paced tour to see everything, or a standard 3 hr tour with only the main sites. I asked for the longer slower tour and he met us a whole hour before the standard start time. He paced the walking at a comfortable slow pace
author: Irene_M

title: Magical AlHambra Visit
text: I booked this last minute and the company and Carlos went out of their way to make the visit happen when all others told me it was impossible to get tickets. They even worked with me at 10pm on a Sunday night to make it happen the next morning! Carlos Sanchez was a fabulous guide who provided so much historical background to our visit. He also went out of his way to ensure my mobility challenged father saw everything and had a great time. If visiting Granada and looking for a private, exclusive and informative visit to AlHambra ensure to use this company and ask for Carlos!
author: Roberta_L

title: Beautiful site
text:
The tour of the Alhambra and palaces was extensive and informative. We appreciated our private guide very much as he pointed out details that we would not have been able know on our own.
Initially the tour company made an error and booked our tickets for the wrong day. Fortunately we were able to reschedule and not miss this beautiful site.
